course_name_original: Expresión gráfica y diseño asistido por ordenador i
course_name_en: Graphic expression and computer-aided design i
prerequisites: It would be convenient for the student to have taken a technological Baccalaureate or some module in the mechanical field.
Knowledge of CAD tools is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Correctly applies spatial vision and graphic representation techniques, both through traditional methods of metric geometry and descriptive geometry, and through computer-aided design applications.
Knows standardization bodies and their products. Interprets and uses technical drawings and catalogs. Creates assemblies and exploded views of mechanisms and products. Masters 2D and 3D CAD systems.

Masters tools for managing one's own identity and activities in a digital environment (being digital). Searches for and obtains information autonomously according to reliability and relevance criteria (searching). Organizes information with appropriate tools, whether online or in-person, that allow for the development of academic activities (organizing). Prepares information with appropriate tools and formats for the communicative situation and does so honestly (creating). Uses ICTs to share and exchange information (sharing).

syllabus_topics: Industrial Drawing. Types of technical drawings. Rotation. Formats. Scales. Plans.
Representation. Systems of representation. Orthogonal cylindrical projection. Projection methods. Types of lines.
Measurement. Length measurement: Graduated ruler, compass calipers, vernier caliper, micrometer. Angle measuring devices. Exercises.
Dimensioning. Basic principles and regulations. Methodology. General criteria.
Manufacturing Processes. Classification. Lathe. Drilling. Milling. Threading...
Fastening and Motion Transmission Elements. Standardized representation and definition of elements under study. Drawings.
Assembly Representation. Basic principles and regulations. Methodology. General criteria.
Axonometric System. Representation systems. Representation according to axes.
CAD. Computer tools. Basic representation commands in Autocad. Application of theoretical fundamentals to computer drawing.

assessment_methods.method: Personal assignments and specialization project (ICT workshops)
Development problems (sheets, weekly tests, other tests)

assessment_rules: To pass the course, all conceptual groups, tests, and assignments must be passed; no averaging between these categories is permitted. Mandatory submissions for assignments and in-class exercises receive a zero if not delivered. If ICT workshops are failed, they cannot be improved or rescored. For the second call, all conceptual groups must also be passed without averaging. Evaluative tests include a conceptual test (minimum 4/10 required to proceed) and a practical part.
bibliography: AENOR, UNE Standards on Technical Drawing
FELEZ, J. and MARTINEZ, M.LUISA, Industrial Drawing, Ed. Sintesis
